sloka: तम् तु इदानीम् अहम् हत्वा खर दूषण घातिनम् ।रामम् शर्म उपलप्स्यामि धनम् लब्ध्वा इव निर्धनः ॥३-५४-२५॥
transliteration: tam tu idānīm aham hatvā khara dūṣaṇa ghātinam ।rāmam śarma upalapsyāmi dhanam labdhvā iva nirdhanaḥ ॥3-54-25॥

translations.english: I will be happy only after killing the destroyer of Khara and Dusana, just as a poor man feels happy only on acquiring wealth.
